tools.name: daftra_get_site_info
tools.description: The Daftra account this API key belongs to: id, business name, subdomain, country, timezone, date format, default currency and subscription expiry. Check the date format and currency here before creating records. GET /site_info.

tools.name: daftra_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (customers), 20 per page by default. Search by name, number, email or phone with `keywords`. Each item is wrapped in a `Client` object. GET /clients.

tools.name: daftra_get_client
tools.description: One client by id (contact details, balance settings, currency, address). GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: daftra_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices (and debit notes), most recent first. Filter by client, payment status, dates or free text. By default each item has the header and client; set recursive=1 for line items, payments and taxes. GET /invoices.

tools.name: daftra_get_invoice
tools.description: One standard invoice by id with line items, payments, taxes, custom fields and client. Other document types (estimate, credit note) answer 404. GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: daftra_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes), most recent first. Filter by client, status, dates or free text. GET /estimates.

tools.name: daftra_get_estimate
tools.description: One estimate (quote) by id with line items, taxes and client. GET /estimates/{id}.

tools.name: daftra_list_invoice_payments
tools.description: List payments recorded against invoices, most recent first. Opening-balance and client-credit payments are excluded. GET /invoice_payments.

tools.name: daftra_list_client_payments
tools.description: List payments received from clients, most recent first. Opening-balance and client-credit payments are excluded. GET /client_payments.

tools.name: daftra_list_products
tools.description: List products and services (name, code, price, stock) ordered by name. Search by name, code, barcode or tag with `keywords`. Each item is a `Product` object. GET /products.

tools.name: daftra_get_product
tools.description: One product by id with images and categories. GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: daftra_list_product_categories
tools.description: List product categories with their parent category. GET /product_categories.

tools.name: daftra_list_stores
tools.description: List stores (warehouses) the key's user may view. Use the ids to filter stock transactions. GET /stores.

tools.name: daftra_list_stock_transactions
tools.description: List processed stock movements (in, out, transfers), most recent first. Filter by product, store or date range. GET /stock_transactions.

tools.name: daftra_list_treasuries
tools.description: List treasuries and bank accounts the key's user may view, with balances. Use the ids when recording expenses. GET /treasuries.

tools.name: daftra_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses (money out), most recent first, with amount, vendor, category and treasury. Filter by dates, amount, category, vendor or status. GET /expenses.

tools.name: daftra_get_expense
tools.description: One expense by id. GET /expenses/{id}.

tools.name: daftra_list_incomes
tools.description: List incomes (money in that is not an invoice payment), most recent first. Same filters as expenses. GET /incomes.

tools.name: daftra_list_taxes
tools.description: List the taxes configured for the account (name, rate, active). Use the ids as tax1/tax2 on invoice lines. All taxes come in one reply. GET /taxes.

tools.name: daftra_list_purchase_invoices
tools.description: List purchase invoices (bills from suppliers), most recent first. Search by supplier or filter by payment status. GET /purchase_invoices.

tools.name: daftra_get_purchase_invoice
tools.description: One purchase invoice by id with line items, supplier, taxes and payments. GET /purchase_invoices/{id}.

tools.name: daftra_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers. Filter by name, address, postal code, country or status. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: daftra_get_supplier
tools.description: One supplier by id. GET /suppliers/{id}.

tools.name: daftra_list_notes
tools.description: List notes recorded against clients, invoices, estimates, purchase invoices, staff, suppliers, products and work orders: text, the record it belongs to (item_type + item_id), author, follow-up status. GET /notes.

tools.name: daftra_create_client
tools.description: WRITE: create a client (customer). Only business_name is required. Without an email the client is created as offline (no email sending). Returns the new client's id and client_number. POST /clients.

tools.name: daftra_update_client
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing client. Partial update: only the fields you pass change; business_name cannot be emptied. PUT /clients/{id}.

tools.name: daftra_create_supplier
tools.description: WRITE: create a supplier. business_name is required; email is required unless is_offline is true. Returns the new supplier's id. POST /suppliers.

tools.name: daftra_create_expense
tools.description: WRITE: record an expense (money out of a treasury). amount and date are required; the treasury defaults to the primary one and the currency to the account currency. Pass unique_id so a retry cannot create it twice. Returns the new expense id and number. POST /expenses.

tools.name: daftra_create_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a sales invoice for a client with line items. It is saved as a DRAFT unless you pass draft=false; a final invoice posts to the books and stock. Returns the new invoice id. POST /invoices.

tools.name: daftra_add_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a client, invoice, estimate, purchase invoice, supplier, product, staff member or work order. The note is private unless share_with_partner is true. POST /notes/{type}/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: daftra_list_clients · Private data: daftra_get_site_info, daftra_get_client, daftra_get_invoice, daftra_list_notes, daftra_create_expense, daftra_add_note · Public sink: daftra_list_clients, daftra_create_client, daftra_create_supplier, daftra_create_expense, daftra_create_invoice, daftra_add_note · Destructive: daftra_get_site_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: daftra_list_clients · Private data: daftra_get_site_info, daftra_get_client, daftra_get_invoice, daftra_list_notes, daftra_create_expense, daftra_add_note · Public sink: daftra_list_clients, daftra_create_client, daftra_create_supplier, daftra_create_expense, daftra_create_invoice, daftra_add_note · Destructive: daftra_get_site_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
